chapter: Regal Theatre, bebop and the Woody Herman date
title: Annual 15-piece big band date at the Conrad Hilton
summary: He still books a big band, this week at the Conrad Hilton ballroom with four rhythm, bassist Eddie and a singer.

blocks.x: Do you still book gigs with a big band, or --
Yeah, occasionally. I'm doing one this week, Saturday. It's a big thing I always play. And DQmita Jo and Jack Carter are on the show.
It's going to be at the Conrad Hilton International Ballroom. I do it every year and they have different stars every year.
How many men do you use?
You use three rhythm or four?
Yeah, right, right, right, and then I got Gerald -- well, Eddie is playing bass with me.
Yeah, Eddie, and then Geraldine is going to do the singing with me, and so --
